name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: The version dropdown on a title's details page now lists the copy on every server that has it, including a server that is currently offline (marked offline) so you can see where else the title lives. When one server has several copies, each is labelled with its resolution and file size so you can tell them apart. Before, a copy on an offline server was left out, which hid the dropdown for most titles while a friend's server was down.
